card.name: Drug names heading interaction entries
card.fires_on: The drug name, or the colon, dash or first letters right after it, at the start of an interaction entry in a drug-interaction list. It also fires inside a drug name that is the interacting drug.

modes.label: Separator after drug name
modes.description: Colon or dash right after an interacting drug name that begins an entry.

modes.label: Inside or just after drug name
modes.description: Part of an interacting drug's name, or the repeat of the name opening the entry.
